label: Market Close
headline: Dow -1.1%, Nasdaq +0.4%, Nvidia -2.9%, Palo Alto +7.8% after hours, Anthropic IPO priced at $83
stance: The Dow fell again while the Nasdaq rose. Fed minutes and Waller put a 50bp December hike in play.

scorecard.actual: Wrong way by the close: Nvidia -2.9% at $150.96. Up 1.0% after hours at 6:42pm.

scorecard.call: Fed minutes today, with the 10y at 5.10%.
scorecard.actual: Minutes (2:00pm): a couple of officials open to more than 25bp in December. 10y closed 5.07%.

scorecard.call: US futures rose overnight on the chip results.
scorecard.actual: Only the Nasdaq held the gain, +0.4%. S&P -0.2%, Dow -1.1% at the close.

sections.title: Macro & Rates
bullets: Fed's Waller floated a 50bp hike to break 3% inflation (10:13am). Barr backed further hikes (1:39pm).
Gold and silver at 14-month lows (5:50pm). Dollar index 103.81, +0.3%, at 6:04pm.

sections.title: Equity Markets
bullets: VIX 24.56 at the close, -0.90. First drop in 5 sessions.
Russell 2000 +0.5%. Its 50-day average is now below its 200-day (6:12pm).

sections.title: Credit & Liquidity
bullets: IG OAS 92bp Tuesday, +2bp from Monday. Today's moves are not in it yet.
ETFs tracking credit default swaps on AI borrowers are set to launch (6:38pm).

items.head: Anthropic prices IPO at $83, above range
items.body: Raises over $81bn, the largest offering on record (6:39pm). Trading starts Thursday on Nasdaq.

items.head: Palo Alto +7.8% after hours on beat
items.body: Fiscal Q1 beat on sales and profit (4:26pm). Buying Applied Compute for $4.5bn. Shares +7.8% at 6:42pm.

items.head: Everpure +4.1% after hours
items.body: Revenue +51% y/y and raised full-year guidance (4:05pm). Shares +4.1% at 6:37pm.

items.head: UnitedHealth -10.2%, biggest Dow drag
items.body: Fell on a federal proposal to expand Medicare Advantage audits (4:18pm).
